research_question: On a published pragmatics benchmark and the same local base model, does an explicit pragmatic decomposition improve exact answer accuracy beyond both direct answering and generic deliberation?

dataset.name: PUB: Pragmatics Understanding Benchmark
dataset.paper: Sravanthi et al. (2024), Findings of ACL, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.719
dataset.license: MIT as declared by the official dataset card
dataset.release_discrepancy_note: The current official archives contain 2,563 task-12 rows and 1,000 task-13 rows, while the paper text reports 2,500 and 2,000. Archive hashes and observed counts are frozen; no rows are silently fabricated or dropped.

sampling.method: lowest SHA-256 ranks of task_id and public item_id
sampling.exclusion_reason: Only source rows 0 and 1 were viewed while auditing archive schemas before preregistration.
sampling.option_order: one deterministic SHA-seeded permutation per item, shared by all conditions

conditions.B0_DIRECT: same item and model; immediate JSON answer only
conditions.B1_GENERIC_DELIBERATION: same item and model; generic observations, two reasoning steps, counterargument, uncertainty, then answer
conditions.OURS_PRAGMATIC_LOOP: same item and model; literal content, pragmatic target, context evidence, alternative interpretation, uncertainty, then answer

metrics.primary: paired exact-answer accuracy, OURS_PRAGMATIC_LOOP versus B1_GENERIC_DELIBERATION
metrics.secondary: OURS_PRAGMATIC_LOOP versus B0_DIRECT and task-stratified accuracy
metrics.uncertainty: 20,000 item-paired bootstrap repetitions and exact two-sided McNemar test
metrics.cost: prompt tokens, completion tokens, and wall latency per condition

success_gate.interpretation: All gates are required. Failure is retained as a result, not tuned away.

evidence_boundary: This is a project-specific, same-model prompt intervention on public PUB items. It can test a narrow operational pragmatic decomposition. It is not guaranteed uncontaminated from base-model pretraining, is not the paper's exact published prompting score, has one frozen option permutation rather than full PPA, and cannot establish longitudinal person modeling, felt understanding, human preference, or Uruha fidelity.
